features.text: STATIC HAND & WRIST SUPPORT: Provides therapeutic positioning for mild to moderate contractures and thumb adduction.
BEND-TO-FIT ADJUSTABILITY: Allows easy, tool-free customization of wrist and finger angles for progressive therapy.
THUMB ADDUCTION CONTROL: Promotes functional alignment for patients with neuromuscular conditions.
HEAT-MOLDABLE PLATFORM: Can be shaped by a clinician for progressive extension therapy.
COLOR-CODED STRAPS: Ensure consistent and accurate fit for users and caregivers.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Mild to moderate contracture of the wrist, hand, and fingers
